Teacher panel

PPP timing: Presentation 20 · Practice 45 · Production 25. The page is deliberately longer than 90 minutes if every discussion expands; use the minute labels as cut-off points.

Answer key

Adjectives: crocodile — dangerous; tortoise — slow; spider — ugly; dog — cute; tiger — fast; horse — strong.
Spelling: strong, slow, dangerous, ugly, fast, cute.
Pet Shop count: cats 1; rabbits 4; parrots 2; goldfish 6; tortoises 3; iguanas 1; dogs 2; hamsters 5.
Odd one out: 1 kangaroo; 2 snake; 3 monkey; 4 spider.
Jo’s listening task: snake; a walk; hamster.
George 3.33: clever; the garden; red and green vegetables; water; one rabbit.
Negative sentences:
Their parents don’t want an iguana.
Jackie doesn’t like cartoons.
Jason doesn’t go to the park with his parents.
Their parents don’t go to the park.
Ticket booth: “Can I have a ticket, please?” → “Here you are.” → “Thanks.”

Quick teaching notes

After every click task, ask for one full sentence: “A tiger is fast.” / “I can see four rabbits.” / “Dogs like a walk.”
For a very beginner learner, accept one-word answers first, then model the full sentence and have her repeat it.
The mini Jo audio is a new short browser-spoken text made for this lesson because only track 3.33 was supplied as an MP3.
